description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMongoEventAdapter' that implements the 'EventAdapter' interface for handling event serialization and deserialization with MongoDB in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages converting Event objects to JSON/BSON for journal storage and parsing BSON back into Event objects, including error handling and logging.

classes.name: AbstractMongoEventAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class implementing EventAdapter for serializing and deserializing Event objects to and from MongoDB BSON/JSON formats, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Returns the type of the event as a string manifest.

methods.name: toJournal
methods.description: Converts an Event object into a BSON/JSON format suitable for journal storage.

methods.name: fromJournal
methods.description: Converts BSON data from journal into an Event object.

methods.name: tryParseEvent
methods.description: Attempts to parse a JsonValue into an Event, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses a JsonValue into an Event object, setting default revision.
